t: 美军在密西西尼瓦河战役中袭击了莱纳佩村庄。
te: U.S. forces attack a Lenape village in the Battle of the Mississinewa.
dz: 1812 年战争：美军在密西西尼瓦河战役中袭击了莱纳佩村庄。
de: War of 1812: U.S. forces attack a Lenape village in the Battle of the Mississinewa.

t: 法国颁布米兰法令，确认了大陆体系。
te: France issues the Milan Decree, which confirms the Continental System.
dz: 拿破仑战争：法国颁布米兰法令，确认了大陆体系。
de: Napoleonic Wars: France issues the Milan Decree, which confirms the Continental System.

t: 阿兹特克历代石发现于墨西哥城埃尔佐卡洛.
te: The Aztec calendar stone is discovered at El Zócalo, Mexico City.
dz: 阿兹特克历代石发现于墨西哥城埃尔佐卡洛.
de: The Aztec calendar stone is discovered at  El Zócalo, Mexico City.

t: 美国革命:法国正式承认美国.
te: France formally recognizes the United States.
dz: 美国革命:法国正式承认美国.
de: American Revolution: France formally recognizes the United States.

t: 四方联盟之战:大不列颠向西班牙宣战.
te: Great Britain declares war on Spain.
dz: 四方联盟之战:大不列颠向西班牙宣战.
de: War of the Quadruple Alliance: Great Britain declares war on Spain.

t: 第一次输血的叙述以医生Richard Lower到化学家Robert Boyle的一封信的形式…
te: The first account of a blood transfusion is published, in the form of a letter from physician Richard Lower to chemist …
dz: 第一次输血的叙述以医生Richard Lower到化学家Robert Boyle的一封信的形式发表 在皇家学会的哲学交易中
de: The first account of a blood transfusion is published, in the form of a letter from physician Richard Lower to chemist Robert Boyle, in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society

t: 高延泽成为了日本皇帝.
te: Go-Yōzei becomes Emperor of Japan.
dz: 高延泽成为了日本皇帝.
de: Go-Yōzei becomes Emperor of Japan.

t: 由巴伐利亚的欧内斯特所领导的部队在哥德斯贝格围城击败由格布哈德·特鲁克塞斯·冯·瓦尔德堡所领导…
te: Forces under Ernest of Bavaria defeat troops under Gebhard Truchsess von Waldburg at the Siege of Godesberg.
dz: 科隆战争:由巴伐利亚的欧内斯特所领导的部队在哥德斯贝格围城击败由格布哈德·特鲁克塞斯·冯·瓦尔德堡所领导的部队.
de: Cologne War: Forces under Ernest of Bavaria defeat troops under Gebhard Truchsess von Waldburg at the Siege of Godesberg.

t: 教宗保禄三世将英格兰的亨利八世逐出.
te: Pope Paul III excommunicates Henry VIII of England.
dz: 教宗保禄三世将英格兰的亨利八世逐出.
de: Pope Paul III excommunicates Henry VIII of England.

t: 苏丹纳西尔-于·丁·迈赫穆德在德里的军队被帖木儿所击败.
te: Sultan Nasir-u Din Mehmud's armies in Delhi are defeated by Timur.
dz: 苏丹纳西尔-于·丁·迈赫穆德在德里的军队被帖木儿所击败.
de: Sultan Nasir-u Din Mehmud's armies in Delhi are defeated by Timur.

t: 玛格丽特二世,海诺特伯爵夫人和神圣罗马皇后与她的儿子威廉一世,巴伐利亚公爵,签署和平条约以结束…
te: Margaret II, Countess of Hainaut and Holy Roman Empress and her son William I, Duke of Bavaria, sign a peace treaty end…
dz: 玛格丽特二世,海诺特伯爵夫人和神圣罗马皇后与她的儿子威廉一世,巴伐利亚公爵,签署和平条约以结束胡克和科德战争.
de: Margaret II, Countess of Hainaut and Holy Roman Empress and her son William I, Duke of Bavaria, sign a peace treaty ending the Hook and Cod wars.

t: 帕干国王克约斯瓦被三个明赛会兄弟推翻,标志着帕干王国事实上的终结.
te: King Kyawswa of Pagan is overthrown by the three Myinsaing brothers, marking the de facto end of the Pagan Kingdom.
dz: 帕干国王克约斯瓦被三个明赛会兄弟推翻,标志着帕干王国事实上的终结.
de: King Kyawswa of Pagan is overthrown by the three Myinsaing brothers, marking the de facto end of the Pagan Kingdom.

t: 刺杀诺曼底伯爵威廉·朗斯活佛.
te: Assassination of William Longsword, Count of Normandy.
dz: 刺杀诺曼底伯爵威廉·朗斯活佛.
de: Assassination of William Longsword, Count of Normandy.

t: 罗曼诺斯一世·勒卡佩诺斯被加冕为未成年的君士坦丁七世的同母异族.
te: Romanos I Lekapenos is crowned co-emperor of the underage Constantine VII.
dz: 罗曼诺斯一世·勒卡佩诺斯被加冕为未成年的君士坦丁七世的同母异族.
de: Romanos I Lekapenos is crowned co-emperor of the underage Constantine VII.

t: 托蒂拉国王手下的奥斯特罗哥特人通过贿赂东罗马驻军来掠夺城市.
te: The Ostrogoths under king Totila plunder the city, by bribing the Eastern Roman garrison.
dz: 围攻罗马:托蒂拉国王手下的奥斯特罗哥特人通过贿赂东罗马驻军来掠夺城市.
de: Siege of Rome: The Ostrogoths under king Totila plunder the city, by bribing the Eastern Roman garrison.

t: 古罗马庆祝了第一个土星利亚节.
te: The first Saturnalia festival is celebrated in ancient Rome.
dz: 古罗马庆祝了第一个土星利亚节.
de: The first Saturnalia festival is celebrated in ancient Rome.
